device_observation.message: NO VALID MATCHING SESSION. No boot result can be inferred.

host_policy_review.synthetic_check_scope: Production Python classify/init_eligibility evaluated with the transcribed 12 header bytes and separate zero/0xff synthetic tails. Both reject as INVALID_HEADER. Not a device dump, full-record scan or physical C/EFI execution.
host_policy_review.c_policy_reviewed: NativeMaintenance.h jl2_classify rejects bad magic/out-of-range fields; jl2_prepare returns with ready=0 before any commit. NativeFirmware.h jl_arm_query also rejects the header.
host_policy_review.export_path_reviewed: Maintenance.c freezes a fixed-size raw snapshot and can export an invalid DBGC header; it does not initialize during export. native_maintenance.publish saves a complete verified capture but emits no initialization token when INVALID_HEADER.
host_policy_review.stability_scope: Read.c/jl_freeze compares live-before, frozen-copy and live-after CRCs for one capture. STABLE=1 does not validate header format, RAM ownership or reset retention.

conclusion: Reported complete power-off invalidates any assumption that this RAM contains the previous session. The invalid header is compatible with that history but does not identify the writer, prove a mapping fault or prove an XNU crash. Current MAINT-v2 has no admitted cold-start initialization path for an invalid header.
